livingCosts.notes: HSG 'Cost of living: expenses for Bachelor's students per month' (source: Federal Statistical Office SSEE 2024 survey): accommodation incl. utilities CHF 795; food CHF 440; transport CHF 195; personal = communication CHF 45 + clothing CHF 130 + leisure CHF 210 + other (insurance, taxes, gifts) CHF 170. Excludes health (CHF 190) and tuition. HSG's own total is CHF 2,175 a month and it recommends budgeting CHF 25,000-30,000 a year.

programmes.name: Bachelor of Arts in Business Administration
programmes.notes: Tuition for foreign nationals CHF 3,343.50 per semester x 2, from autumn semester 2026 (about 7% rise after fees were unchanged since 2014). Non-refundable application and processing fee CHF 268. No separate compulsory semester contributions are listed. 3-year (180 ECTS) bachelor's; the assessment year and most of the bachelor's are taught in German (some English tracks). HSG offers no engineering, computing, sciences or arts bachelor's.

programmes.name: Master of Arts in Business Management
programmes.notes: Tuition for foreign nationals CHF 3,557.50 per semester x 2, from autumn semester 2026. Non-refundable application and processing fee CHF 268. No separate compulsory semester contributions are listed. 3-semester (90 ECTS) master's (MUG), taught in German with English electives.

programmes.name: Master in Computer Science
programmes.notes: Tuition for foreign nationals CHF 3,557.50 per semester x 2, from autumn semester 2026. Non-refundable application and processing fee CHF 268. No separate compulsory semester contributions are listed. 4-semester (120 ECTS) master's (MCS), taught in English. HSG's only computing degree; its arts-type master's (MOK) was discontinued in 2025.
